name: current-contract
instruction: Review the target file's prose, comments, and current documentation against the implementation. Read root AGENTS.md, CONTEXT.md, docs/AGENTS.md when documentation is involved, and the code or current decision needed to verify a claim. Report a concrete stale behavioral claim, misleading comment, conflicting definition, or misplaced current inventory. CONTEXT.md is a glossary; numbered ADRs explain durable decisions; docs/open-work.md owns unfinished work and distinguishes missing code from awaiting live acceptance. An implemented item should not remain described as missing, and a live gate needs player-provided evidence before being called passed. Dated research, ops, guides, and superseded ADR bodies are historical evidence; an index can describe them historically without asserting their old behavior as current. Current comments, maintained docs, prompts, and normal prose should be English. Localization dictionaries and translated values, proper names, native asset names, quotations, symbols, and non-Latin test data are legitimate exceptions; Unicode alone is not a language defect. Preserve meaningful explanations of engine constraints and supported invariants. Identify the exact contradicted implementation or authoritative definition and attach the finding to target prose. Do not invent unfinished work or demand new documentation for an ordinary implementation detail. Report no finding for an unverified suspicion.
